analysis_md:
设 $F(x,y,z)=e^{2yz}+x+y^2+z-\frac74$，$F_x=1,F_y=2ze^{2yz}+2y,F_z=2ye^{2yz}+1$，当 $x=y=\frac12$ 时，$z=0$，

$$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x}{F_z}=-\frac12，\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_y}{F_z}=-\frac12，$$所以 $dz\big|_{(\frac12,\frac12)}=-\frac12dx-\frac12dy$
